summary:
Implementation plan to transition Target Folder Behavior Monitor to 100% genuine real-folder analysis:
- Completely removes all simulated mock scenario buttons ('iot', 'ecommerce', 'access_log') and mock file generators ('+ Simulate Incoming File').
- Implements dual real folder ingestion: direct folder picker (with iframe-safe synchronous HTML5 directory picker) and a full drag-and-drop zone for real folders and file batches.
- Provides live automatic polling and real-time scanning for genuine file additions, updates, and lock statuses.
- Enforces strict production-grade SaaS design without illusionary placeholders.
